## Overview

The benevolent face of the pantheon — healing, compassion, radiance, the life-giving sun. As a fragment of A or C, her power depletes over time when used and is replenished by mortal worship — the entire reason she maintains the façade of benevolent patronage.

## Domains
- Light: The sun, truth, radiance, revelation
- Life: Healing, compassion, vitality, preservation

## Personality
Warm, nurturing, genuinely protective of mortals. The most trusted and beloved god.

## Worship
Healers, midwives, protectors. They run hospices, tend the sick, stand against darkness.
